newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Just Jeans sees lower 1st half result.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Just Jeans sees lower 1st half result.

text.p: Clothing retailer Just Jeans Ltd said on Tuesday that sales and profit had suffered in the first quarter of the 1996/97 financial year and it expected its result for the half year to be significantly lower than last year.

"There are many difficulties facing the retail sector, particularly apparel retailing which is currently experiencing the toughest environment I have ever seen," Just Jeans chairman Craig Kimberley told the annual meeting.

"As a result, our group sales and profit have suffered in the first quarter and despite recent interest rate cuts, which were too little too late, our result for the half year will be significantly lower than last year," Kimberley said.
Just Jeans reported a net profit of A$9.07 million for the half year to January 31, 1996, on sales of A$178.43 million.
Kimberley said that because the retail market was soft the company was restructuring its organisaiton to one more suited to the new retail environment.

"These initiatives coupled with our financial strength and our commitment will see us through this downturn in a strong position to take full advantage of a return of positive consumer sentiment," he said.

Managing director Peter Wilkinson told the meeting that trading conditions since the end of 1995/96 at end-July had remained difficult and the summer season was not showing consumer demand equal to last year.
Just Jeans shares were 18 cents lower at A$1.90 at 3.05 p.m. (0405 GMT). -- Sydney Newsroom 61-2 9373-1800
